recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片呈模糊的無定形嗜鹼性背景，細胞輪廓不清、核固縮或溶解（ghost cells）；切片中骨小樑之間的骨髓大片呈淡粉紅色壞死（星號），僅少部分殘存有活性細胞（箭頭），而殘存腫瘤細胞免疫染色呈瀰漫強陽性——急性骨髓性白血病合併骨髓壞死。
features: Panel A (aspirate, low power): amorphous granular basophilic-to-eosinophilic background with indistinct cell outlines
Panel B (aspirate, high power): degenerated 'ghost' cells with smudged, pyknotic or karyorrhectic nuclei and vacuolated debris
Panel C (H&E biopsy): extensive coagulative marrow necrosis (asterisk) with loss of nuclear detail between bony trabeculae
Panel C: residual viable cellular marrow in an adjacent intertrabecular space (arrow)
Panel D (IHC): diffuse strong cytoplasmic staining of the viable leukemic infiltrate (marker not labeled)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (A, B) consist largely of amorphous, granular necrotic material with degenerated cells showing indistinct cytoplasmic borders and smudged or pyknotic nuclei, precluding a reliable differential count. The trephine biopsy (C) shows extensive coagulative necrosis of intertrabecular marrow (asterisk) with a residual focus of viable hypercellular marrow (arrow); bone trabeculae appear intact. Immunohistochemistry (D; antibody not labeled) shows diffuse strong staining of the viable leukemic cells. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis secondary to acute myeloid leukemia (reported as acute myelomonocytic leukemia); lineage and subtype should be established on viable tissue, peripheral blood or repeat sampling.

ddx.vs: Viable tumor at the necrotic edge is cohesive and keratin-positive, CD45- and myeloid marker-negative.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell crisis or DIC-related marrow infarction
ddx.vs: Infarction in these settings lacks a viable blast population and is associated with sickled cells or consumptive coagulopathy.
Gelatinous transformation shows fat atrophy with pale extracellular mucopolysaccharide (Alcian blue-positive) and preserved but hypocellular cells, not ghost cells.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia or high-grade lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Viable lymphoblasts or lymphoma cells express TdT/CD19/CD3 or CD20 and lack myeloid/monocytic markers.
